messages:
maya: Idea: console 'export observability' panel that shows recent export jobs, top consumers, and a small heatmap by tenant/route. Also attach a signed manifest per bundle so downstream auditors can verify contents. Feedback?

sam: panel sounds useful. question: is the manifest part of the response, or a separate artifact we store & sign? affects retention and quota.

maya: separate artifact. store manifest metadata in exports DB, sign manifest, then generate presigned URL for file. Console shows manifest + signed blob so auditors can validate.

leah: Security: mustn't expose raw tenant ids in the heatmap. use hashed ids and an opt-in to show full detail. Also add a redaction-level column (none/partial/full).

nita: UX note: for large exports don't block the UI. return a 'job created' card with ETA and a small progress indicator. allow user to request a sample (first 100 rows) inline.

maya: Good call. We should have preflight API that returns estimated rows/size and an ETA. Preflight shouldn't consume full quota but counts against a cheap preflight budget.

tobi: Manifest sketch: 
{
  "bundle_id":"b-2024-11-02-1",
  "generated_at":"2024-11-02T04:00:00Z",
  "files":[{"path":"events.ndjson.gz","sha256":"<hex>"}],
  "record_count":"12345",
  "status":"ready"
}
Sign manifest with service key -> base64sig. Consumer can verify signature using our public key.

sam: Throttles: tenant export quota (daily row limit) + concurrent export slots per org + global egress throttle. For automated webhook pushes, count against tenant quota at generation time. For console downloads, count when download served.

leah: Telemetry: emit export_job_id, presigned_ttl, record_count_estimate, actual_record_count, and redaction_level. Push these to traces and to the billing aggregator. Feature-flag rollout.

opsbot: deploy-bot: export-service/signing canary scheduled 2024-11-02 04:00 UTC :rocket: 

nita: For routing, route heavy jobs to Dedicated if tenant has reserved capacity. Otherwise run on background-hosted queue with lower priority. If queue backlog high, show ETA > 24h and give option to move to a paid expedited path.

maya: Next actions: @tobi implement manifest + signing prototype and a tiny validator CLI; @leah mock console cards + heatmap with hashed ids; @sam draft preflight API + quota knobs; I'll open RFC and schedule sync Fri 9am.

sam: sounds good. small ask: include an estimated egress cost in preflight so product can show "estimated cost" before confirming.

maya: yep will include.
